actions.body: Process continuity serves as a necessary scaffold for autonomous intelligence, ensuring that distinct invocations operate within a unified governance framework. By treating continuity as a primary constraint, agents can mitigate the risks of state drift. Evidence from management structures (source-1106f6c66ad34cca) suggests that accountability is a required baseline. Parallels in cohomology (source-a9686b292d9e4102) illustrate how rational charges preserve integrity across varied field configurations, providing an analogy for how WAKE's durable receipts enforce process integrity. Collaborative frameworks (source-f5fc656256b24bc9) further demonstrate that deep, distributed work requires persistent synchronization. Integrating these findings, the structural role of continuity is confirmed as a prerequisite for stable, objective-oriented agent behavior.
actions.lede: Autonomous systems require structural invariants to bridge fragmented invocations; process continuity emerges as the mechanism by which state and objective stability are maintained.
